env.world: A potential-outcome system for a binary instrument with treatment-induced sample selection and a finite ordered outcome. Each unit carries a covariate cell \(X\in\mathcal X\) on a finite set equipped with the discrete measurable structure \(2^{\mathcal X}\), so that every singleton \(\{x\}\) is measurable, a binary instrument \(Z\), potential treatments \(D_0,D_1\in\{0,1\}\), potential selection indicators \(S_0,S_1\in\{0,1\}\), and potential outcomes \(Y_0,Y_1\in\mathcal Y=\{0,1,\ldots,K-1\}\) with \(K\ge3\) ordered levels. The received treatment is \(D=D_Z\), selection is \(S=S_D\), and the outcome \(Y=Y_D\) is recorded only on \(\{S=1\}\); the observed element is \(O=(X,Z,D,S,SY)\), which is measurable into the finite discrete observed carrier \(\mathcal X\times\{0,1\}^3\times(\mathcal Y\cup\{\star\})\), so its pushforward law \(P_{\mathrm{obs}}=\mathcal L(O)\) is a probability law and every observed atomic event is the pushforward of a measurable event. The five system variables \(X,Z,D,S,Y\) occupy pairwise distinct nodes of the system, and the ambient sample space carrying the unit-level randomness is standard Borel, so that conditional independence given \(X\) is well posed. The latent law \(P\) is the joint law of \((X,Z,D_0,D_1,S_0,S_1,Y_0,Y_1)\); \(C=\{D_1>D_0\}\) is the complier stratum, \(\pi(x)=P_{\mathrm{obs}}(Z=1\mid X=x)\) the instrument propensity, and \(p_x=P_{\mathrm{obs}}(X=x)\) the cell probability. The target is the survivor-complier probability of benefit \(\theta=P(Y_1>Y_0\mid S_1=S_0=1,C)\), and \(\gamma_{ij,x}=P(Y_0=i,Y_1=j,S_0=S_1=1,C\mid X=x)\) is the survivor-complier outcome subcoupling. A latent cellwise direction \(d(x)\in\{-1,+1\}\) indexes the permitted weak selection-monotonicity direction. \(\mathcal M\) is the class of latent laws satisfying the maintained restrictions, \(\mathcal X_+(P)=\{x:p_xm(x)>0\}\) its positive-survivor support, and \(\varepsilon_Z,\kappa_\sigma,m_\star\) are the overlap, direction-separation, and aggregate survivor-mass constants.

env.world: A finite capacity-and-transport world. For each covariate cell \(x\) on a finite set \(\mathcal X\) and each level of the finite ordered support \(\mathcal Y=\{0,\ldots,K-1\}\), two nonnegative capacity arrays \(\ell_i(x)\) and \(h_j(x)\) are given, with totals \(q_0(x)=\sum_i\ell_i(x)\), \(q_1(x)=\sum_jh_j(x)\), gap \(\Delta q(x)=q_1(x)-q_0(x)\), exact mass \(m(x)=\min\{q_0(x),q_1(x)\}\), and prefix/tail aggregates \(\ell_{\le t},\ell_{<t},\ell_{>t},h_{\le t},h_{>t}\). The branch-free exact-mass partial-transport polytope is \(\Gamma_x^{\ast}=\{\gamma_x\ge0:\sum_j\gamma_{ij,x}\le\ell_i(x),\ \sum_i\gamma_{ij,x}\le h_j(x),\ \sum_{i,j}\gamma_{ij,x}=m(x)\}\), with the exact-row, exact-column, and doubly-exact variants \(\Gamma_x^{+},\Gamma_x^{-},\Gamma_x^{0}\) retained for comparison and \(\Gamma_x=\Gamma_x^{\ast}\). The benefit functional is \(b_x(\gamma_x)=\sum_{i<j}\gamma_{ij,x}\), and the threshold cuts are \(B_L(x)=\max\{0,\max_t[\ell_{\le t}(x)-h_{\le t}(x)]+\min\{\Delta q(x),0\}\}\) and \(B_U(x)=\min\{m(x),\min_t[\ell_{<t}(x)+h_{>t}(x)]\}\), with active faces \(\mathcal A_L(x)\) and \(\mathcal A_U(x)\). Aggregating with weights \(p_x\) gives \(M=\sum_xp_xm(x)\), \(\theta_L=\sum_xp_xB_L(x)/M\), \(\theta_U=\sum_xp_xB_U(x)/M\), the endpoint map \(\Psi=(\theta_L,\theta_U)\), and the interval \(\Theta_I=[\theta_L,\theta_U]\).

env.world: An i.i.d. sampling and asymptotic-inference world on the fixed finite observed support. A single sampling probability space \((\Omega,\mu)\) carries an infinite sequence of observations \(O_1,O_2,\ldots\), each measurable into the finite discrete observed carrier, mutually independent under \(\mu\), and each distributed as \(P_{\mathrm{obs}}\); the sample at size \(n\) is the initial segment \(\mathbf O_n=(O_1,\ldots,O_n)\) of that one sequence, so that every sample size is realized on the same space and the objects indexed by \(n\) below form a single stochastic process rather than an unrelated family of finite experiments. The empirical law is \(\widehat P_n=n^{-1}\sum_{r\le n}\delta_{O_r}\), with empirical cell masses \(\widehat p_x\). Empirical conditional probabilities given \((X=x,Z=z)\) use the empirical ratio when the denominator is positive and the value zero otherwise; they form the raw contrasts \(\widetilde\ell_i(x),\widetilde h_j(x)\), stacked as \(\widetilde c_n\), which are projected onto \(\mathfrak C=\prod_{x}\mathbb R_+^{2K}\) by the coordinatewise positive part \(\widehat c_n=\Pi_{\mathfrak C}(\widetilde c_n)\), giving \(\widehat\ell_i(x),\widehat h_j(x)\) and hence \(\widehat q_0(x),\widehat q_1(x),\widehat{\Delta q}(x),\widehat m(x),\widehat B_L(x),\widehat B_U(x)\). Cells are screened by \(\widehat r_x=\widehat p_x\widehat m(x)>\eta_n\) with \(\eta_n>0\), \(\eta_n\to0\) in the ordinary sense, and \(\sqrt n\eta_n\to\infty\) — the screening sequence is NOT assumed monotone in \(n\) — giving \(\widehat M_n,\widehat N_{L,n},\widehat N_{U,n}\) and the endpoint estimator \(\widehat\Psi_n\), with fallback \((0,1)\) when \(\widehat M_n=0\). Asymptotics use the multinomial Gaussian limit \(\mathbb Z_{P_{\mathrm{obs}}}\) of the empirical cell-probability vector, the localization tolerance \(a_n=(n\eta_n)^{-1/4}\) with estimated near-active faces \(\widehat{\mathcal A}_{L,n}(x;a_n),\widehat{\mathcal A}_{U,n}(x;a_n)\), a conditional multiplier process \(\mathbb G_n^{\xi}=n^{-1/2}\sum_r\xi_r\{\delta_{O_r}-\widehat P_n\}\) built from mean-zero unit-variance multipliers \(\xi_r\) (diagnostic only, never a calibrated critical value), and — for the finite-sample guard — the finite observable event class \(\mathcal E=\{\{X=x\}\}\cup\{\{X=x,Z=z\}\}\cup\{\{X=x,Z=z,D=d,S=1,Y=k\}\}\), its maximal empirical deviation \(\delta_n=\max_{E\in\mathcal E}|\widehat P_n(E)-P_{\mathrm{obs}}(E)|\), the union second-moment threshold \(b_{n,\alpha}=\sqrt{|\mathcal E|/(4n\alpha)}\), the capacity-and-screening envelope \(A_{n,\alpha}=64K|\mathcal X|b_{n,\alpha}/\varepsilon_Z^2+|\mathcal X|\eta_n\), the alpha-indexed deterministic guard \(g_{n,\alpha}=\min\{1,4A_{n,\alpha}/m_\star\}\), the guarded confidence set \(\mathcal C_{1-\alpha,n}=[\max\{0,\widehat\Psi_{n,L}-g_{n,\alpha}\},\min\{1,\widehat\Psi_{n,U}+g_{n,\alpha}\}]\) at level \(\alpha\in(0,1)\), and the triangular-array law class \(\mathcal P_n\).

citations.verbatim_statement: Assumption 1: \(\mathbb D\) and \(\mathbb E\) are Banach spaces, and \(\phi:\mathbb D_\phi\subseteq\mathbb D\to\mathbb E\) is Hadamard directionally differentiable at \(\theta_0\) tangentially to \(\mathbb D_0\). Assumption 2: \(\theta_0\in\mathbb D_\phi\), the \(\mathbb D_\phi\)-valued estimator \(\widehat\theta_n\) satisfies \(r_n\{\widehat\theta_n-\theta_0\}\rightsquigarrow\mathbb G_0\) in \(\mathbb D\) for some \(r_n\uparrow\infty\), and \(\mathbb G_0\) is tight with support included in \(\mathbb D_0\). decisions.rationale: Upstream deleted the symbol `g_n` and the asymptotic radius `512K|𝒳|(a_n+η_n)/(m★εZ²)`, replacing them with the finite event class `𝒠`, its deviation `δ_n`, the threshold `b_{n,α}=√(|𝒠|/(4nα))`, the envelope `A_{n,α}`, and `g_{n,α}=min{1,4A_{n,α}/m★}`; the theorem now asserts BOTH every-sample uniform containment at level `≥ 1-α` AND the retained fixed-α uniform endpoint-error convergence with rate `O(n^{-1/2}+η_n)`, and `a_n` survives only as the diagnostic face tolerance. decisions.decision: The screening sequence \(\eta_n\) is positive with \(\eta_n\to0\) and \(\sqrt n\eta_n\to\infty\) and is NOT monotone: every `Antitone η` hypothesis and the `Antitone ηL` conclusion conjunct are deleted (F1 round-6 revision, tracking the upstream `fix-source` repair).
decisions.rationale: F3 halted `thm:uniform-deterministic-guard` with `sorry -- BLOCKER: statement-wrong (the stated hypotheses on L do not imply Antitone ηL)` (TUniformDeterministicGuard.lean:111) and the escalation was routed `fix-source`. The counterexample stands: \(L_n=(n+1)^{1/4}\) times 2 on even \(n\) and 1 on odd \(n\) is positive, tends to infinity, and is \(o(\sqrt n)\), yet \(\eta_n=n^{-1/2}L_n\) increases infinitely often, so `Antitone ηL` is false, not merely unproved. Upstream repaired the source rather than the proof, and the frozen core now grants \(\eta_n\) only positivity, \(\eta_n\to0\), and \(\sqrt n\eta_n\to\infty\), saying in three separate places that no monotonicity in \(n\) is assumed or used. The plan's defect was in the S3 world text, which wrote \(\eta_n\downarrow0\) and thereby licensed F2 to add an `Antitone η` binder to both asymptotic theorems and an `Antitone ηL` conjunct to the guard's \(L_n\) corollary. Repair by DELETION, not by strengthening a premise: adding `Antitone L` would make the delivered corollary narrower than what upstream now states, and no delivered conclusion needs monotonicity — both theorems consume the screening level only through `atTop`-eventual facts (\(\eta_n\) eventually below the positive constant \(\rho/2\), and \(n^{-1/2}=o(\eta_n)\)), while the finite-sample containment bound is a pointwise-at-`n` estimate. Deleting a hypothesis strictly widens both theorems, so nothing is narrowed. Closure applied: the S3 world text and notes (\(\eta_n\downarrow0\) corrected, encoding directive added); `thm:uniform-deterministic-guard` (stale `Antitone etaL` sync-back superseded, statement of record restated with the corollary's four surviving clauses and their one-line proofs); and `thm:branch-free-pointwise-directional-limit` (the same binder deleted, with the core's own 'no monotonicity … is used' sentence recorded). Not touched, because they neither carry nor imply a monotonicity side condition: `def:plugin-endpoint-estimator` and `def:face-aware-inference-handle` take `η` as a plain parameter and require only positivity where the guard radius is formed; `oeq:uniform-face-multiplier`'s payload records the screening threshold \(\eta_n\) without any monotonicity clause, matching the core's OEQ text verbatim; and every purely algebraic or PO-side node is unaffected. No disposition, `reuse`, `defer_tier`, `gate`, member list, or `hyps` list moved, and no `ass:` node was added or removed — monotonicity was never atomized as an assumption in the core.
